skill.name: brand-guidelines

content.value_statement: Inconsistent colors and typography weaken Anthropic-branded materials. This skill provides documented palettes, font rules, fallbacks, and styling guidance for coherent visual artifacts.
actual_capabilities: Supplies four main colors and three accent colors with hexadecimal values.
Assigns Poppins to headings and Lora to body text.
Defines Arial and Georgia as fallback fonts.
Guides accent color use for non-text shapes.
Describes RGBColor use in python-pptx presentations.
limitations: Does not include logos, images, templates, or implementation scripts.
Requires Poppins and Lora to be installed for the intended typography.
Provides broad styling rules, not layout specifications for every artifact type.
Does not verify current external brand standards or legal approval.

use_cases.title: Restyle a presentation
use_cases.description: Apply the documented palette, heading fonts, body fonts, and accent rules to an existing deck.

use_cases.title: Prepare branded communications
use_cases.description: Create consistent visual treatments for reports, announcements, and internal communication materials.

use_cases.title: Implement presentation themes
use_cases.description: Translate the supplied colors and font rules into python-pptx formatting decisions.

prompt_templates.title: Apply the core palette
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the documented Anthropic color palette to this artifact: [artifact]. Keep text readable and use orange as the primary accent.

prompt_templates.title: Set typography
prompt_templates.prompt: Style [content] with Poppins headings and Lora body text. Use Arial and Georgia when the preferred fonts are unavailable.

prompt_templates.title: Restyle a presentation
prompt_templates.prompt: Restyle this presentation for [audience]. Apply the documented colors, typography hierarchy, background contrast, and rotating accent colors to non-text shapes.

prompt_templates.title: Audit brand consistency
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit [artifact] against the supplied Anthropic styling rules. List each inconsistency, explain its impact, and propose an exact replacement.

output_examples.input: Style a title slide with a dark background and one accent.
output: Use the dark main color for the background.
Set the title in Poppins with the light main color.
Use orange for the primary non-text accent.

output_examples.input: Review a report that uses Times New Roman headings and blue body text.
output_examples.output: Replace heading text with Poppins and body text with Lora. Use the dark main color for body text on light backgrounds.

output_examples.input: Prepare typography for a system without the preferred fonts.
output_examples.output: Use Arial for headings and Georgia for body text while preserving the existing hierarchy.

best_practices: Provide the artifact, audience, and required output format.
Install Poppins and Lora before generating final materials.
Check text contrast after applying background and accent colors.
anti_patterns: Do not use every accent color with equal emphasis.
Do not assume preferred fonts exist on every system.
Do not treat these styling rules as complete trademark or legal guidance.

faq.question: Which colors does the skill provide?
faq.answer: It provides dark, light, mid-gray, light-gray, orange, blue, and green colors with hexadecimal values.

faq.question: Which fonts should headings use?
faq.answer: Headings should use Poppins, with Arial as the fallback.

faq.question: Which fonts should body text use?
faq.answer: Body text should use Lora, with Georgia as the fallback.

faq.question: Does the skill install fonts?
faq.answer: No. Install Poppins and Lora separately when exact typography is required.

faq.question: Can it guide python-pptx styling?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents RGB colors and typography decisions suitable for python-pptx presentation formatting.

faq.question: Does it include complete brand assets?
faq.answer: No. It contains styling guidance but does not include logos, images, templates, or implementation scripts.
